what: On hover the button lifts 2px, a shadow spreads and the background deepens one tone (.25s ease), and a pale light streak tilted 115° sweeps from outside the button’s left (−140%) to outside its right (140%) over .7s ease. On release the streak returns the same way and sweeps once more in reverse. The arrow cell shifts 2px to the right

options.--fx-ease: Light beam curve (via style), default ease
options.--fx-lift-dur: Lift, background and shadow duration, default .25s
options.--fx-bg / --fx-bg-hover / --fx-fg / --fx: Background, hover background, text, and light-beam colors (default accent background · white light 22%)
options.look: In light, a white button with accent-color text, light rays at 12% accent

note: CSS only. The original laid the button inside as a three-cell grid of 120px text · 1px vertical line · 20px arrow — cell layout is up to the user
